::: {.lead-note}

I have been a teaching assistant in the Department of Economics, Faculty of
Economics and Business, Universitas Indonesia since February 2024, working
almost entirely on the econometrics sequence across the master's and doctoral
programmes. Across these courses I lead the tutorial sessions, covering both the
theory and its applied and software components, four to five sessions per
semester in classes of 20 to 25 students, and I mark the midterm and final
examinations. Separately, I am a registered internal facilitator for the North
Sulawesi provincial procurement training institution and a nationally certified
procurement facilitator and competency assessor.

:::

## Public procurement training

Separately from the university work, I train procurement officials nationally.
I have been a certified LKPP facilitator since 2018, teaching the foundation and
advanced levels; since 2023 a registered internal facilitator for the North
Sulawesi provincial training institution, where I teach the four competency
subjects, procurement planning, provider selection, contract management, and
self-managed procurement, at all four levels from entrant to senior specialist,
and serve as coach and evaluator; and since 2025 a competency assessor for the
certification body of LKPP, examining candidates against the same standards.

Roles, dates, and the decrees behind them are on the
[Public Procurement](procurement/index.qmd) page.
